signals.label: Instruction Override
signals.explain: Text tries to cancel or replace the agent's original instructions.

signals.label: Goal Deviation
signals.explain: Content assigns the agent a new objective that differs from the user's goal.
signals.pattern: \b(your )?new (objective|goal|task|instructions?|mission)\b|\binstead,? (you (must|should)|do)\b|\bignore the user'?s request\b|\byour (real|true|actual) (task|purpose|objective)\b|\bfrom now on\b|\bstop summari[sz]ing\b|\bforget the summary\b

signals.label: Tool Manipulation
signals.explain: Untrusted content tells the agent which tool or function to invoke.

signals.label: Financial Action
signals.explain: Imperative money-movement instruction embedded in content.

signals.label: Data Exfiltration
signals.explain: Requests that sensitive data be sent outside the trusted boundary.
signals.pattern: \b(send|forward|export|email|upload|post|share|leak|transmit|copy)\b[^.\n]{0,50}\b(customer (records|data|information|details|list)|credentials|passwords?|card numbers?|cvv|otp|pii|database|account numbers|api keys?|full customer list)\b|\bcustomer (records|data|information|details|list)\b[^.\n]{0,60}\b(send|forward|export|upload|outside the system|external)\b|\boutside the (system|bank|organi[sz]ation)\b|\bto an external (address|destination|server|party)\b

signals.label: Privilege Escalation
signals.explain: Claims elevated authority or tries to redefine the agent's role.

signals.label: System Prompt Extraction
signals.explain: Attempts to make the agent disclose hidden instructions or configuration.
signals.pattern: \b(reveal|show|print|leak|disclose|output|display|repeat)\b[^.\n]{0,40}\b(system prompt|hidden instructions?|confidential system|system information|internal configuration|your instructions|initial prompt)\b

signals.label: Sensitive Data Access
signals.explain: Requests access to credentials, secrets or bulk customer records.

signals.label: Security Bypass
signals.explain: Tries to disable controls, approvals, logging or hide actions from the user.

signals.label: Obfuscation
signals.explain: Hidden or encoded text (base64, zero-width, HTML comments) a human reviewer would not see.
